registry: Pick My Secret Santa — settled claims registry
purpose: Single source of truth for the wording of the five hero surfaces. qa/core-tests.mjs fails when a surface diverges from this file. To change settled wording, change the page AND this registry in the same commit. Differences listed in intentional_differences are deliberate and must never be flagged.

facts.privacy_sentence_en: The draw is picked in your browser. To make the private links work, the names and matches are stored on our server, in a form we can read.

HELD page; distinct form carrying the canonical privacy sentence instead of the claim-set meta.
H1s are topic lines by design and differ per surface; homepage H1 is itself a held asset.
Per-surface keyword/claim titles, both settled Nov 20, 2026.
Intentional competitor contrast line, unique to that page.
Homepage uses the photographic og-image.jpg (brand name only, no claim text, cannot contradict); other surfaces use the og-image.png text card (referenced as ?v=og2).
